raw_text: Seeing a huge push for SFJ's Khalistan referendum on social media. The engagement numbers look highly suspicious — thousands of retweets from accounts with zero followers and creation dates within the last week. Has anyone done a proper bot analysis? The organic Sikh community I know is actually quite divided on this issue but the online narrative makes it seem unanimous.
clean_text: Reddit r/Sikh discussion noted suspicious engagement patterns on SFJ referendum posts, with thousands of retweets from newly created zero-follower accounts suggesting bot network amplification.
